blocks.arabic_text: أَلْيَنُكُمْ مَنَاكِبَ فِي الصَّلوةِ، وَمَا مِنْ خَطْوَةٍ أَعْظَمُ أَجْرًا مِنْ خَطْوَةٍ مَشَاهَا رَجُلٌ إِلَي فُرْجَةٍ فِي الصَّفِّ فَسَدَّهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار باسناد حسن، وابن حبان في صحيحه كلاهما بالشطر الاول ورواه بتمامه الطبراني في الاوسط الترغيب:٣٢٢/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “The best of you is the one who keeps his shoulders soft in Salah, and the step a man takes to fill an empty place in the row earns the very greatest reward.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- Keeping the shoulders soft in Salah means: if someone wishes to join the row, the worshippers on his right and left should soften their shoulders and make room for him so that he can join the row.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ سَدَّ فُرْجَةً فِي الصَّفِّ غُفِرَ لَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البزار واسناده حسن مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٢٥١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Juhaifah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever fills an empty place in the row, his sins are forgiven.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ وَصَلَ صَفّاً وَصَلَهُ اللهُ، وَمَنْ قَطَعَ صَفّاً قَطَعَهُ اللهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه ابوداؤد، باب تسوية الصفوف رقم:٦٦٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever joins the row, Allah will join him to His mercy, and whoever breaks the row, Allah will distance him from His mercy.”
